asset.name: StatusIndicator
asset.description: The compact status component combining icon, text, shape, and animation policy to express certainty and urgency independently rather than as one flat variant set.

requires.reason: Status shape and glyph come from the registry.
Status labels use the shared text styles.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.

rationale: Certainty and urgency are orthogonal, and for a system full of agent and async work the distinction is load-bearing: an agent predicting a failure must not render identically to a failure that happened.
